notes:
New: AI agents (MCP). AI apps such as Claude Desktop and Claude Code can now read your project and, if you allow it, edit it and work Corylus for you. Install the module in Settings → AI agents (MCP), add Corylus to your AI app there, and choose per project what agents may do: nothing, read only, ask you before each change, or change freely.

You stay in control: agents reach Corylus only while it is open and only from this computer, every change is snapshotted first, the activity log lets you undo any of them, and Pause stops all agent requests at once. Agents can never delete anything for good or change your settings.

Security: a review of the new agent features closed several holes. Search results now show document text as plain text, so a page cannot be made to run code hidden inside a document; agents can no longer create a Story Bible entry outside your project; and the files that let an AI app reach Corylus are private to you from the moment they are written.

macOS: Corylus is not notarized yet, so Gatekeeper may say the app cannot be opened because the developer cannot be verified. Right-click (or Control-click) Corylus.app, choose Open, then Open again. Only needed once per downloaded copy.
